title: Crossing different datasets
body: Combine information from different tables in the same answer
example: E.g.: active companies by CNPJ + election results in the same municipality

title: Mathematical calculations
body: Averages, sums, counts, and operations specific to your analysis
example: E.g.: infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births

title: Sorting and ranking
body: Classify and order results by your criteria
example: E.g.: the 5 municipalities with the most CNPJs opened this year

title: Change over time
body: Analyze trends and variation over time
example: E.g.: how the IDEB has evolved in public schools since 2010

title: Comparison across groups
body: Differences between regions, categories, or profiles
example: E.g.: the wage gap between men and women

title: Information about the data
body: What each column or variable actually means
example: E.g.: what each type of establishment means in the CNES
